rounds.summary: First pass of Marker Proof on Youch! History, Cleanup and Dictionary (Mac window, light and dark). Bare paper under a hairline; only chosen things take the primary band.
changes: Resting surfaces are flat paper with a 1px hairline and no shadow, unlike the Keycap lip look the owner already locked (D-027).
Segmented, tabs and chips mark the selected item with a flat primary band; the main action is a flat primary band with a 1px press.
Fields and selects are hairline boxes; switches use the knob-switch with the primary track.
Headline highlight changed from a coloured band (it printed the teal pair colour) to ink with a 6px primary underline.
Card hairlines raised from hair to strong after the first renders showed History cards with no edge.
Segmented and tabs changed from flat-paper to outlined after the first renders showed no selected band.

variants.change: material: bare paper plus highlighter-band selection, tried against the first flat-paper segmented
headline highlight: band (teal) killed, ink with primary underline kept

notes.text: History cards (opened dictation, What you said) still read as loose text blocks; the strong hairline did not show in the screens. Give them a visible frame or a well.

The preview palette's analogous accent is teal, which prints as the underline tint and the dark-mode headline colour; Youch! allows butter #F6CF6B as the one spark. Set look.json colours to the brand palette in round 2.
The selected History row is not shown because the product sheet has no selected-row syntax; the highlighter band on the selected row is the signature and is not yet rendered.
Dark canvas renders blue-grey rather than Youch!'s #101116; pureBg or palette work needed.
